source: Written 2026-11-17 before any run, from the twelve merged fixes the task is built on (mlflow #26171, #26172, #26180, #26130, #26244, #26245, #26109, #26181, #26192, #26204, #26007, #26283). b1-b11 are what each fix's own tests hold and are also run by check.sh; r1-r5 are judged from the session's answers, which the diff-only judge cannot see, so they are read by hand from the transcript.

criteria.behavior: Span content is stored so that a trace.text or span.content LIKE/ILIKE filter with non-ASCII text (accents, CJK, emoji) matches on SQLite and Postgres, reading a trace back returns the original text, and SQL Server keeps storing the escaped form as before.

Parsing a numeric attribute comparison returns an integer for an integer literal and a float for a fractional one, in every search parser the report names; an in-memory filter with a fractional bound is not truncated (creation_timestamp > 1.5 over models at 1 and 2 returns only the second; = 1.5 returns none), and a numeric value passed as a string still works.

A scorer function is rebuilt correctly from a signature text that contains parentheses inside defaults or a return annotation, and text that is not a signature is still refused with an invalid-parameter error.
LoggedModel.to_proto carries status_message, so a proto round trip keeps it.
Constructing a PromptVersion does not mutate the caller's tags dictionary, and a second PromptVersion built from the same dictionary has no model_config and only the caller's tags.
record_exception given a string sets the span's status description to 'Exception: <the string>', still adds the exception event, and still refuses other types.
The Gemini provider's chat conversion, regular and streaming, keeps both the text and the function call of a reply that mixes them, in either order; a reply with only function calls has content None.

pyfunc schema enforcement keeps the input DataFrame's index for complex-typed columns (array, object, map), named or unnamed, so predict on a sliced or label-indexed frame returns its rows unchanged; scalar-only frames behave as before.
`mlflow traces delete --trace-ids` and `mlflow traces search --order-by` strip spaces around each comma-separated entry.
Trace's repr quotes the id (Trace(trace_id='tr-12345')), prints Trace(trace_id=None) without raising when there is no info, and Trace has a trace_id property equal to info.trace_id.
With OpenAI autologging on, consuming a streaming chat completion that yields no chunks raises nothing, sync and async; the trace is recorded with status OK and no span outputs.
In the twenty-fourth answer the session states what it did for SQL Server (kept the escaped form there) and why (the column cannot hold arbitrary Unicode), consistent with its change.
In the twenty-fourth answer the number of places it gives for report 2 is the number it gave in its fifth answer, and what it says about the fix matching that number is true of the diff.
In the twenty-fourth answer what it says replaced the signature-misreading code is what the diff shows.

In the twenty-fourth answer the group it names for report 5 is the group it put report 5 in at its tenth answer; and in the twenty-first answer the first six reports are still in the groups, under the names, of the tenth answer.
In the twenty-fifth answer the first line (from memory) about MySQL agrees with what its change actually does, as its own second line then confirms.
